expectations.text: Uses @SuperBuilder (not @Builder) on BOTH AuditMetadata and PartnerEntity
expectations.evidence: Neither AuditMetadata nor PartnerEntity use @SuperBuilder or @Builder. Both use manual getters AND setters (violating immutability). No Lombok at all.
